div.head: VI Atr 16
div.ab: [MS D begins at cap 16] ⁊ gelæste man Godes gerihta georne rihtlice æghwilce geare, þæt is sulhælmessan huru XV niht ofer eastron
⁊ gelæste man Godes gerihta æghwilce geare rihtlice georne, þæt is sulhælmessan huru XV niht ofer eastron.
And ecclesiastical dues shall be promptly and duly rendered every year, namely, plough-alms at the latest fifteen days after Easter.
Und man leiste gesetzmässig willig Kirchengerechtsame in jedem Jahre, nämlich Pflugalmosen spätestens 14 Tage nach Ostern
And let God's dues be paid lawfully and willingly every year, namely plough-alms at the latest a fortnight after Easter
div.note: Here D (CCCC 201 p. 128, c. 1080, after I Cn 7.3 without a break, so treated as Cnut's) begins; K = D, column T = K (Cotton Claudius A III).
